**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Declare server exports (`load(…)`, `onGet(…)`, …) in their own export statement
```

```text
`export *` is not allowed in a route module: server exports must be named
```

```text
Server export wrapper `{name}` must initialize a module-scope `const` (`export const {export} = {name}(…)`)
```

```text
Duplicate server export: `{first}` and `{name}` are both `{kind}(…)`; keep one
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Give each server export its own `export const x = wrapper(…)` statement at module scope (one per kind; request handlers one per method) and replace `export *` with named exports.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { load } from "@rivetjs/router";
export const loader = load(() => 1), other = 2;
export default () => <p />;
```

```tsx prefer
import { load } from "@rivetjs/router";
export const loader = load(() => 1);
export const other = 2;
export default () => <p />;
```

## When it is reported

serverExports option (route modules). Wrappers: load, guard, actions, entries, headers, onRequest, onGet … onOptions from @rivetjs/router (aliases and namespace imports tracked).
